slot_scores.name: no_production_during_training_period
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When a skilled worker trains new workers, does that skilled worker spend their entire two-week training period on training (producing zero food), or can they split their time between production and training within those two weeks?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether the skilled trainer produces during training, covering part of the hidden slot, but did not ask whether trainees also abstain from production during the training period.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost over the 8 weeks, where total cost includes wages for skilled workers, wages for trainees during training, wages for newly trained workers after they finish training, overtime wages, and late-delivery compensation fees?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about and confirmed the optimization objective as minimizing total cost over the horizon.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent never entered READY_TO_MODEL or produced an equivalent final modeling state. H2 was resolved, but H1 remained only partially addressed because trainee production during training was not confirmed.

summary: The agent confirmed the core objective and several training/workforce details, but only partially resolved the no-production-during-training rule by asking about trainers but not trainees. The interaction ended without a final modeling state after repeated unanswered overtime questions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
